segments.text: Welcome back to the channel, today we learn Catalan at the market

chunks.fa: Welcome back to the channel, today we learn Catalan at the market

segments.text: Bon dia, em posa un quilo de taronges?

chunks.voc: bon good, the form bo takes before its noun; dia day, m. — bon dia is the greeting, morning and midday
posa you put, formal (posar · pres. poso pòso · p.p. posat · to put); em to me — em posa, lit. do you put me, is how one asks a shopkeeper for something
quilo kilo, m.; taronja orange, f., pl. taronges — the j is written g before an e
quant how much; valen they cost (valer valèr · pres. valc · p.p. valgut · to be worth, to cost (fut. valdré))

segments.text: Van a dos euros el quilo, senyora

chunks.voc: van they go (anar · pres. vaig · p.p. anat · to go (fut. aniré)) — anar a, of a price, to sell at; not the van of the past, which an infinitive follows
el quilo the kilo — Catalan says the where English says a
senyora madam; ny is the ny of canyon
d'acord all right, agreed (de + acord, agreement)
me n'emporto I'll take (emportar-se · pres. m'emporto m'empòrto · p.p. emportat · to take away with one); n' of them, the en a number asks for when what it counts is not said
aquí here; té you have, formal (tenir · pres. tinc · p.p. tingut · to have (fut. tindré)) — aquí té is here you are
fins until; després after, later — see you later
molt much, many, f. pl. moltes; gràcies thanks
bon dia here a farewell: have a good day
